svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Columns: two UPN 80, 842 long, webs facing each other,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 196 apart (web faces); open sides face outward.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: In each web: 4 x 18 holes at 18 each side of centre, 687 and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 767 up from the column foot (mold bolts).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: In the +Y web only: two 40 access holes on the centre line,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 210 and 611 up from the foot (base pin and upper pin).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: In the -X flange of each column: 2 x 13.5 holes 32 from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: web face, 113 and 158 up from the foot (tie bolts).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Feet: 16 mm plates 140 x 90, 4 x 13.5 holes at 110 x 70.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Beam: two 20 x 100 plates 286 long, on the outside faces of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the column flanges, tops 185 up from the foot; the -X plate

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drilled 13.5 through with the flange holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lugs: two 20 mm plates 80 x 95 between the beam plates, 56

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: apart inside, with a 41 bush hole 210 up from the foot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld on a flat table; check the webs are parallel and 196 apart.
